notAvailable: This page isn't available for your role.

logo.title: Company Logo
logo.description: Shown in the sidebar and as this workspace's browser tab icon, in place of the default initial.
logo.sizeHint: Best fit: a square image, at least 256×256px (PNG, JPG, or SVG, up to 1MB). We'll fit it in the box automatically — if it isn't already square, use "Crop image" to frame it.
logo.tooLarge: Image is too large — please choose one under 1MB

theme.title: Theme Colors
theme.description: Pick a gradient theme — applied to the sidebar, top bar, buttons, and accents in both light and dark mode, always kept readable. Main content stays neutral.

notifications.title: Event Reminder Notifications
notifications.description: When on, founders get a reminder 3 days before a scheduled cohort event — via in-app notification and email (and WhatsApp once configured).

mentorInterest.title: I am interested in being a mentor
mentorInterest.description: When on, you'll show up as an option when assigning a mentor to a pillar, alongside dedicated mentor accounts.
mentorInterest.enabledToast: You're now listed as an available mentor
mentorInterest.disabledToast: You're no longer listed as an available mentor

mentorProfile.title: Mentor Profile
mentorProfile.description: Shown to admins when picking who to assign to a pillar.
